current.text: He signed with Brooklyn on a mutual option deal as veteran depth.
He is projected as Brooklyn's backup center, behind starter Day'Ron Sharpe.
Experts expect a messy split of center minutes with Sharpe and Danny Wolf.
Brooklyn does not own its pick and may give second-half minutes to young players like Clowney and Minott. That puts a veteran backup's March minutes at risk.

durable.text: He is an efficient, high-usage backup big.
He cannot handle a role of 20 or more minutes a night.
